Extract Fitted Values and Residuals for because Models

Source: R/residuals.R
residuals.because.Rd

Bayesian methods for extracting expected fitted values and residuals from fitted because model objects.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'because'
fitted(
  object,
  resp = NULL,
  newdata = NULL,
  ndraws = NULL,
  re_formula = NULL,
  summary = TRUE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'because'
residuals(
  object,
  resp = NULL,
  type = c("quantile", "response", "pearson"),
  summary = TRUE,
  ndraws = 250,
  re_formula = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A because model fit object.

resp

Character string; name of the response variable. If NULL, takes the first response.

newdata

Optional new dataset (currently evaluated within-sample).

ndraws

Integer; number of posterior draws to use. Defaults to all draws (or 250 for quantile residuals).

re_formula

Formula or NA; determines whether random/phylogenetic effects are included. If NULL (default), conditional on random effects. If NA, marginal prediction without random effects.

summary

Logical; if TRUE (default), returns a summarized vector (posterior mean or median). If FALSE, returns the full [ndraws x N_obs] posterior matrix.

type

Character; type of residual: "quantile" (default), "response", or "pearson".

...

Additional arguments.

Value

A numeric vector (if summary = TRUE) or matrix of posterior draws (if summary = FALSE).

References

Dunn, P. K., & Smyth, G. K. (1996). Randomized quantile residuals. Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics, 5(3), 236-244.

Hartig, F. (2022). DHARMa: Residual Diagnostics for Hierarchical (Multi-Level / Mixed) Regression Models (R package version 0.4.6). r-project.org

Gelman, A., & Hill, J. (2007). Data Analysis Using Regression and Multilevel/Hierarchical Models. Cambridge University Press.
